services.name: Why Kicking Horse?
services.desc: “Wow” your guests with a truly romantic and unique experience! Let your event come to life at the top of Kicking Horse Mountain Resort at Canada’s highest elevated venue, the Award Winning Eagle’s Eye Restaurant! Located at 7,700 feet on the top of the Purcell Mountains this magical venue plays host to one of the most wondrous backdrops for weddings in North America. The occasion begins in the Kicking Horse Plaza, where guests can gather to board the Golden Eagle Express Gondola. A scenic ride will bring them to the top of the world where they will be greeted by stunning views of the Canadian Rockies. Couples can say “I do” on the terrace, enveloped by 360˚ views and surrounded by friends,
